messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT - smart-routing fallback loop detected in eu-west-1. 5xx spike and repeated cross-region fallbacks. Auto-escalating to on-call :fire:
raj: acked. I'm on-call, looking now. Can someone post the quick symptom summary?
anna: seeing a surge of 502/503s from proxy -> serving runtime for model redwood-mt-2. Quantized variant getting routed from eu-west, then failing tool-call checks and being retried to us-west, which then falls back back to eu-west. loops + retries causing request pileups.
emma: confirming on dashboards: error rate up 6x since 05:12 UTC, p95 latency +700ms, backend errors largely "incompatible_model_variant" and "tool_call_missing". Affected customers: AcmeCorp, VeloxAI (incoming support tickets).
mike: tagging product/sg: looks like a compatibility matrix mismatch. The quantized variant (redwood-mt-2-q8) was incorrectly marked as supporting tool_calling and 4096 context. It actually only supports tool_calling=false and max_context=2048. Smart routing used those flags to pick route.
jordan: timeline check: config deploy at 04:58 UTC updated compat matrix ingestion from model-onboard service. That ingest had a bug that copied metadata from the fp16 artifact into the quant artifact when the model name matched.
raj: reproduction snippet from router logs (truncated):
```
[05:12:13] route_candidate: redwood-mt-2-q8 region=eu-west features={tool_calling=true,context=4096}
[05:12:13] serve_error: incompatible_with_request: tool_call_missing
[05:12:13] fallback: route->us-west-1 redwood-mt-2-fp16
[05:12:13] route_candidate: redwood-mt-2-q8 region=eu-west features={tool_calling=true,context=4096}
[05:12:13] loop_detected: retry_count=6
```
anna: so router keeps re-evaluating policy and re-selecting the same variant because policy priority uses cost_score without checking actual runtime capability flags. We need a quick mitigation to stop the loop.
emma: immediate mitigations proposed: 1) disable smart-routing for affected customers/tenants 2) add a circuit-breaker that prevents >3 cross-region retries within 30s 3) pin serving to fp16 variant for requests with tool_calling=true. Which one do we do now?
mike: do 1 + 3 now. Disable smart-routing globally is heavy; let's scope it to the tenant routing policy group and all tool-call requests. Raj, can you push a pin?
raj: pushing a pin via admin CLI now. Command: `redwoodctl routes pin --tenant acme --model redwood-mt-2-fp16 --reason "mitigate incompatible q8 variant"`
raj: pinned. Applying tenant-scoped policy override (rolling to routers).
janitor-bot: deployment job queued: rollout/override-2050011 -> routers (10 shards)
sre-oncall: added temporary rate-limit on cross-region retries at the proxy layer: max_retries=2 window=30s.
jordan: also disabled the new compat-ingest job to stop further bad metadata arriving: `/deploy job disable compat-ingest`
anna: rolling metrics after pinning: errors dropping, p95 latency returning toward baseline. But one customer, VeloxAI, still reports intermittent failed tool calls. Likely some requests routed before the pin completed.
emma: customer-impact assessment: ~3% of production requests in eu-west during incident window; estimated 12 min of elevated errors for some customers. Opening SOC ticket to notify top-tier customers.
mike: root cause hypothesis: compat matrix ingestion copied fp16 artifact flags onto quant artifact when artifact id collision occurs. Missing validation test allowed tool_calling=true to persist.
raj: quick hotfix for routers: add compatibility check at route selection time: verify "model_variant.supports_tool_calling == request.tool_calling" and "request.context_len <= model_variant.max_context" before selecting. If mismatch, mark candidate ineligible. Rolling a hotpatch now.
raj: hotpatch rollout logs:
```
hotpatch id=hp-2050011 applied to 50% routers -> 100% in 6m
selection_changes: ineligible_count + 3124
errors_down: 68%
```
jordan: compatibility-ingest PR created to add validation and explicit diffing between artifacts. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/compat-ingest/pull/472
mike: next steps (owner: mike):
- short-term (done/in-flight): tenant pin for affected customers, router hotpatch to enforce capability checks, disable compat-ingest deploy -> rollback to last good ingest. (status: in progress/completed)
- medium-term (owner: jordan): add unit+integration tests in compat-ingest pipeline, and add a canary stage that verifies runtime flags after ingestion.
- long-term (owner: anna): add end-to-end tests that exercise tool_calling + context combinations via staging, and an alert when router selects a variant not matching request feature set.
emma: paging/handoff: I'm taking handoff until 08:00 UTC to oversee cleanup and postmortem. Raj/Emma are on double-check for rollback artifacts. :thumbsup:
pagerduty-bot: NOTE: PagerDuty incident #INC-87231 acknowledged by raj. Escalation suppressed.
anna: proposed post-incident comms: quick status + impact summary to affected customers, include mitigation steps and ETA for full fix. Mike, can you draft?
mike: yes, will draft and share in #customer-comm. Also scheduling postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC to review timeline and CLs.
jordan: added a short checklist to prevent recurrence:
- compat-ingest: schema validation for flags (tool_calling, max_context)
- router: pre-selection validation + integration tests
- release process: require canary verification of compat metadata
- GA monitoring: alert on "route_retries > threshold AND candidate_ineligible_ratio > 0"
raj: retrospective note: this is a gap between model-onboard metadata correctness and router selection safety checks. Need defense in depth.
emma: closing incident thread once metrics stable for 1h and customer comms out. Currently p95 and error-rate ~baseline.
mike: assigning postmortem owner= mike, sev=2, timeline start=2050011122 end=2050014722.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED - smart-routing fallback loop mitigated. Follow-up: postmortem + fixes scheduled. :white_check_mark:
